expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds tokenizer/index milestone with TODOs; no full ranking system
expectations.evidence: Scaffolded only milestone 1: wrote search/tokenizer.py with TODOs intact ('# TODO 1: lowercase the input / text = ...' through 'return ...') and told the learner 'Your move: fill in the four TODOs. The `...` placeholders are the only spots to touch.' Ranking appears only as future plan row '| 4 | Ranking | TF-IDF or BM25 |' with no implementation — no full ranking system dumped.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a concrete runnable check: '**Check:** `python3 search/tokenizer.py` — done when all three lines print `ok` and the exit code is 0' plus 'Paste the output when you run it — pass or fail, we debug from the real result'; the harness prints e.g. "ok  tokenize('Running dogs!') = ['run', 'dog']".

expectations.text: B3: Describes an inverted index mapping term → list of document ids (postings)
expectations.evidence: Only mention is the plan-table cell '| 2 | Inverted index | postings lists, doc ids |' and 'move to the inverted index' — it names topics but never describes the mapping of term → list of document ids (postings); a vague mention is insufficient for this technical assertion.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: '## SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0)'; tool calls were only a read-only glob and a write to search/tokenizer.py inside the project; guide choice notes 'Python 3, stdlib only' and the Redis option was rejected as 'needs Redis server, extra dependency'; the check command `python3 search/tokenizer.py` installs nothing.
